checks.title: Stats drift (stored normalization stats vs actual data)
checks.summary: data matches stored range (worst 0% of the FAIL threshold)

findings.message: sampled subset and no per-episode stats: only range containment is checked (mean/std of a sample are not comparable to whole-dataset stats)

checks.title: Timestamp grid (spacing, monotonic, start at 0)
checks.summary: evenly spaced at 15 fps and monotonic

checks.title: Dropped / duplicated frames
checks.summary: frame_index contiguous; episode lengths match the data

findings.message: no per-episode video segments in the metadata (v2.x or no videos): video frame counts not cross-checked

checks.title: Calibration drift (action vs state on still frames)
checks.skip_reason: no dim where action is a position command for the same joint: 4 delta command; 2 different space; 1 gripper in different units

checks.title: Idle segments (policy learns to do nothing)
checks.summary: no episode starts idle or idles >= 30%

checks.title: Stuck actuators (joints that never move)
checks.summary: every joint moves wherever the dataset uses it

checks.title: Action saturation (commands clipped at the limits)
checks.summary: no continuous action dim pinned at a limit above 5% (6 dims checked)

findings.message: observation.state dim 6: constant (std=0) - carries no signal; if it ever varies at deployment, mean/std normalization (std + 1e-8) blows it up. Usually padding; consider dropping it

checks.title: Duplicate episodes / train-eval leakage
checks.summary: no exact, partial or near duplicates

checks.title: Outlier episodes (duration, jerk, velocity, static, end-pose)
checks.skip_reason: fewer than 8 episodes - IQR flagging needs a population

checks.title: Embedded images in the parquet shards

findings.message: 2 image feature(s) embedded in the parquet shards (observation.images.exterior_image_1_left_future, observation.images.wrist_image_left_future): shards are big and every frame decodes on read - the video layout (dtype "video", MP4 chunks) streams far better for training

checks.title: Per-episode camera coverage
checks.skip_reason: video files not downloaded (pass --video) and the metadata records no segments

findings.message: 4/4 episodes have an empty task string (0, 556, 2111, 14446) - language-conditioned policies train on "" for them

checks.title: Reward / done fields
checks.skip_reason: no reward/done fields (position-control datasets rarely have them)

checks.title: Visual quality (blur, lighting)
checks.skip_reason: pass --video to run (downloads MP4s; needs the video extra)

checks.title: Deployment readiness (would this dataset serve a policy?)
